text: Hey, Max ... {sarcastic1}remember when you found that time machine and went back to 1964 and met Momma Bosco?
{happy1}Yeah!
{sarcastic1}Out of curiosity, did anything ever ... happen with that?

{suspicious1}Uhh ...
{sarcastic1}You know, did you guys get down to anything untoward? {confused1}Or toward even?
{sarcastic1}Maybe while Sam was in the time machine?
{exuberant1}You can tell me. I’ll put it in the vault.

{incredulous1}Wow, that’s older than some frozen burritos I’ve sucked down.

{sarcastic1}When Kent found out that an early draft of the 18th Amendment contained a clause outlawing the sale of games and amusements, {exuberant1}he opened this place in secret {sarcastic1}so makers and enthusiasts would always have a place to go.

Max, {confused1}give me the skinny on your pockets.
{aloof1}Excuse me?
{sarcastic1}You know, where you keep all that stuff.
{mocking1}That’s like Hollywood magic, right?

{confused1}Really?
{aloof1}No, I never went to college.
Max, {confused1}how’d you learn to play cards?
Funny you should ask!
This one time, {happy1}Sam and I were busting up a crime syndicate down in Atlantic City. A road job.
{confused1}Indeed.

{happy1}Yeah! So we’re tailing this {devilish1}low level mafia bum for an hour and {happy1}he pulls up outside a casino and before he can go in Sam says, {sarcastic1}“Well, little buddy, we better nab this guy quicker than a Pittsburgh driver taking a left on a green in rush hour.”
{incredulous1}I couldn’t have agreed more.
{devilish1}So I grab a tire iron out of the back seat, right, hop out of the Desoto, and {happy1}pummel this guy like a pinata.
{worried1}Yow!
{happy1}Blindfold and all!

{confused1}Do you need anybody roughed up?

{shocked1}HUH?

{happy1}But I wake up and I realize {ecstatic1}this is ridiculous. {happy1}Nobody can kill Heavy Weapons Guy!
{embarassed1}Riiiiight ...

{thinking1}Is best.
{thinking1}BLU man.
Tycho.

{Happy1}This is good soldier ... this one is good doctor ... you are demolition man ...

{happy1}A fellow numismatist!

No. [She doesn’t]

Cash.

{mocking1}[To the player] Am I right?
